concept: A step on a canvas: a small level-2 pane with a title, ports where links attach, and chosen glass with a ring when picked.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a node card as a flat white box with a coloured header bar
default_to_avoid.kind: node card, flow node, graph node, pipeline step, canvas card
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured header bar shouts and hides which node is picked; Pane lifts the picked pane with chosen glass and a ring

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a node is a level-2 pane on the canvas and lifts while it is dragged

derivation.consequence: the rim and sheen are white at low opacity, like light catching an edge
derivation.form: the picked node takes the chosen glass of the system, never a hue of its own

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: Enter or Space picks it and the arrow keys move it, ten steps with Shift

variants.reason: A uses the system material and its chosen state (P3). B adds a hue the concept does not ask for. C loses where links attach.

root.why: a level-2 pane held between a min and a max width on the canvas

head.why: icon, titles and the toggle share one row

icon.why: the icon is in the secondary tone at icon size

titles.why: title and meta stack with a small gap

title.why: the title is label size, medium weight, primary tone

meta.why: the meta line is caption size in the secondary tone

toggle.why: the collapse toggle is a small button with a 44px press area

body.why: the body sits under a hairline at the field rhythm

port.why: a port is a small knob on the edge where a link attaches

in.why: the in port sits on the start edge

out.why: the out port sits on the end edge

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the node is reached by keyboard

data-selected.why: the picked node takes the chosen glass and the ring

data-dragging.why: while dragged the node lifts one level so it reads above the others it passes

hover.why: the toggle washes on hover so the pointer shows it can be pressed

aria-expanded=false.why: a closed node turns its chevron to say the body is hidden

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the edge and the picked ring are drawn by the system

box-shadow.why: the lift eases in at the hover duration so a picked node rises instead of jumping

transform.why: the chevron turns at the hover duration so the reader sees the body open or close
